title: Mini POS scorecard
subtitle: The trial's money test against the control pharmacies, the supporting measures, and the weekly review.

access.deniedTitle: No access to the Mini POS scorecard
access.deniedHint: Your account does not hold the Mini POS scorecard grant. Ask an administrator if you need it.
access.unreachableHint: Your access could not be checked, so this screen stays closed. Try again in a moment.

failed: SIS.Api did not answer. Try again in a moment.

notes.money: Money is SAR, net of VAT.
notes.cost: Cost (and so the margin) is today's item master cost, not the cost at the time of sale.

form.configHint: Leave a date or the offset blank to use the trial calendar SIS.Api is configured with.
form.costHint: Enter the promoters' full cost over the whole trial. The payback ratio is judged on that cost prorated to the counted days (the trial less the settling-in week).

window.noSettlingIn: No settling-in week: the uplift counts the whole trial.

money.title: The money test
money.bars: Go at {{go}} or above. No-go below {{noGo}}. In between, the panel weighs the supporting measures.

band.go: Payback ratio {{ratio}}: at or above the go bar
band.panel: Payback ratio {{ratio}}: between the two bars
band.no-go: Payback ratio {{ratio}}: below the no-go bar

verdictHint.go: The gross margin on the uplift covers the prorated promoter cost at least 1.2 times.
verdictHint.panel: Between the bars: the panel weighs the supporting measures.
verdictHint.no-go: The gross margin on the uplift covers less than the prorated promoter cost.
verdictHint.no-cost: Enter the promoter cost to get a ratio.
verdictHint.no-base: The trial or the control pharmacies sold nothing in last year's days, so there is no growth to compare.
verdictHint.unknown: SIS.Api sent a verdict this screen does not know.

pharmacies.empty: No trial or control pharmacy is set.

holdToBilled.title: Till time to complete an order

returns.title: Return rate
returns.hint: At the Mini POS pharmacies, over the trial.

weekly.title: Weekly review
weekly.hint: Operations and IT review this every week. Any off-list line stops Mini POS everywhere; a pharmacy under half paid two weeks running is paused.

offList.title: Off-list lines sold through Mini POS
offList.clear: No off-list line: nothing to stop.
offList.stop: Compliance stop: {{n}} off-list lines were sold through Mini POS. Stop Mini POS everywhere.

paid.title: Paid share per pharmacy per week
paid.empty: No Mini POS orders in the trial yet.
paid.legend: Under half: fewer than half the week's orders paid. Pause: under half two weeks running.
paid.pauseList: Pause and fix before resuming: {{stores}}. Under half paid two weeks running.

failure.invalidHint: Check the trial dates, the settling-in end, the offset (1 to 400 days) and the cost.
failure.deniedTitle: No access to the Mini POS scorecard
failure.deniedHint: Your account does not hold the Mini POS scorecard grant.
failure.failedTitle: The scorecard could not be read
